Verdict: FAIL — Fall into Destruction.
Demanding absolute non-engagement sacrifices strategic communication for performative tribal outrage.
Democratic strategist James Carville harshly criticized House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries for attending a sit-down meeting with Jared Kushner, demanding Democrats enforce strict party boundaries.

The Bright Side:
Calling out potential backroom deals and demanding institutional accountability is a necessary function of political opposition.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Carville frames the meeting as a failure of moral purpose (WHY). Structurally, it is an error of operational scope (HOW), substituting performative outrage for effective governance.

Social Physics Analysis:
Performative outrage acts as a pretext to enforce internal party conformity, projecting disloyalty onto opponents to hoard political influence without offering solutions.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
Mapping stated purity against actual isolation plots a trajectory toward Greater Evil, where political discourse collapses into perpetual tribal warfare.

The Unavoidable Truth: Refusing to speak with political adversaries guarantees ideological paralysis.

The Unavoidable Lie: That partisan isolation equals moral strength.
